attchmntText: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Additional Disclosure w.r.t Resignation of Mr. Suryanarayana Raju Nandyala as Independent of the company w.e.f. November 06, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited filed revised details regarding the resignation of Independent Directors Suryanarayana Raju Nandyala, Uma Garimella, and Leona Ambuja, effective November 06, 2026. The directors cited increasing professional commitments and pre-occupation as reasons for stepping down. All three confirmed there are no other material reasons for their resignation and no disagreements with the Board or Management. The company submitted this information to BSE and NSE in response to a query under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Annexures enclosed include resignation letters and additional disclosures. The filings comply with SEBI Master Circular requirements for independent director resignations.

attchmntText: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the Earnings Conference Call
voiceSummary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. The company reported operational revenue of INR417 crores and operational EBITDA of INR82.28 crores. Management highlighted an order book exceeding INR10,000 crores, with ninety percent international. The company announced a plan to raise up to INR3,000 crores for mergers and acquisitions, subject to shareholder approval. Targets for FY27 include revenue between INR1,900 and INR2,000 crores with twenty percent EBITDA margin. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Postal Ballot Notice   Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited has issued a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for eight agenda items. The proposals include enhancing overall borrowing limits to Rs. 2500 crores, creating security on assets up to Rs. 2500 crores, and increasing limits for loans, investments, and guarantees under Section 186 to Rs. 4000 crores. The notice also seeks approval for appointing Mr. Galla Jayadev and Ms. Urkavalan Jeya Santhi as Independent Directors for five years effective November 06, 2026. Additionally, it proposes changing Mr. Sunil Kumar Kalidindi's designation from Whole Time Director to Managing Director, and Mr. Kartheek Raju Chintalapati's from Non-Executive Director to Whole-Time Director. The company also seeks approval to raise funds through various methods. The e-voting period runs from November 11, 2026, to December 10, 2026.

attchmntText: SIGMA ADVANCED SYSTEMS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about  Submission of Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call for Financial Performance of the Company pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited submitted the audio recording of its earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30-09-2026. The call was held on 06-11-2026. The recording is available on the company website. The link is https://sigmaadvsys.com/investors/announcements/AUDIO-2026-11-09-19-43-02.mp3. This submission is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The company previously intimated the exchange about the call on 03-11-2026. The filing was made by Krishna Chaitanya Sadhu, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The date of this submission is November 10, 2026.
